description: Fetch the full record of a single arXiv paper by ID or URL — everything on its abstract page (arxiv.org/abs/{id}): title, authors, abstract, primary and cross-list categories, submission and update dates, full version history, author comments, journal reference, DOI, and abs/PDF links. Append a version (e.g. 2601.00001v2) to pin a specific version; old-style IDs (hep-th/9901001) and full abs/PDF URLs are also accepted. The full text lives in the PDF — use arxiv/download-paper for that. No authentication required.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: arXiv paper ID or URL. Accepts: a new-style ID ("2601.00001"), a new-style ID with a version suffix ("2601.00001v2"), an old-style ID ("hep-th/9901001", optionally with a version suffix like "hep-th/9901001v3"), or a full abstract/PDF URL ("https://arxiv.org/abs/1706.03762", "https://arxiv.org/pdf/1706.03762v2"). IDs appear in the results of arxiv/list-papers, search, and get-author-papers.
